Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A records office files incoming petitions as dated entries against a named applicant. Each entry carries a document class, a filing date, and a verification check field. Cross-references are logged when entries cite other accounts or dates. No substantive review is assumed at intake; fields await audit.

2) What occurred: The actor opened a petition document on a recorded date naming a foreign-state partner and a status benefit field; the payment authorization field remained unverified. The actor appended a dated relationship-evidence file to the petition, with the authenticity check field left blank. The actor added a coaching log entry dated the interview date, referencing both named parties; the interview attestation field was unverified. The actor marked a fee field as "paid by undisclosed source" in a supplement; the source verification check was never executed.

3) Materials/access observed: One petition document (dated, named applicant), one relationship-evidence file (dated, two named parties), one coaching log entry (dated, interview date), one fee supplement (undisclosed source notation), one account record referenced in the petition. All documents shared the same filing channel and a single case file number.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Payment field sourced to an undisclosed party in a status-benefit petition. Relationship-evidence file authenticity check left blank. Coaching log entry dated same day as interview attestation. Fee supplement notation inconsistent with standard source verification. All four artifacts clustered under one case file number within a narrow date range.
